dr-sung-standing-2.source: grandmissiondentistry.com, GrandMissionDentistry(15of28).webp 3931x5241, Dr. Sung beside Dr. Nguyen. Re-cut 2026-09-21 for BugHerd #85/#88/#92/#106 ("the photo is not centered"): box 930,700,1280,1705 puts his face on the vertical centre line and keeps Dr. Nguyen out of the right edge, which the old 1400px box could not do. The -2 in the key is deliberate: upload-media.mjs skips anything already in the library BY NAME, so a re-cut under the old name would never have reached Instatic.
